label: Plans and features
help: The first column holds feature names, every other column is a plan. The first row is the price line for each plan. Name a row Tagline (a one-line subtitle per plan), Button (each plan's own button text - put a price there for a buy button like $9/mo, or leave a cell empty for no button under that plan), or Link (each plan's destination, so its button becomes a real link) and it drops out of the feature list. Every other row is a feature. In a cell: yes, y, true, check, tick or a check mark draws a tick; no, n, false, x, cross, - or a cross mark draws a cross; a leading >, <, ^ or v becomes an arrow; anything else prints as text. Paste a table straight from your spreadsheet to replace the whole grid.

label: Sub-heading
default: Every plan includes the whole toolkit. Pay for the seats and support you need.

label: Button label
help: The button under every plan. A Button row in the table overrides it per plan; a Link row turns the buttons into real links. Leave this empty (and add no Button row) to drop the button row.

label: Featured plan
help: Which plan column to pick out, counting from 1. Use 0 for no featured plan.

label: Background
help: The text colour follows this automatically: dark ink on a light sheet, light ink on a dark one.

label: Accent
help: Colours the ticks and the featured plan.

label: Layout
help: Cards gives each plan its own panel. Comparison grid is flat, with a hairline under every feature row.
